provenance.paper_title: GraphPilot: GUI Task Automation with One-Step LLM Reasoning Powered by Knowledge Graph

evidence.section: Full paper: Knowledge and Memory Representations
evidence.paraphrase: Offline exploration constructs a graph of pages, element functions, and transition rules used for online planning and validation.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 2): The full-paper lifecycle review found app-specific UI knowledge graph fixed during downstream inference; query-conditioned access, preprocessing, or training-time changes were not counted as persistent deployed updates. No persistent inference-time T2 update or deployment-feedback policy evolution was found.
